name: Endless Rain
source:
In the never-ending rain girl waits for her master alone in the misty forest house.
Master sometimes comes capriciously, insults the girl and leaves again. But for the girl he is  everything in the world.
One day a strange boy and a niece appear before the waiting girl. Will the rain ever stop? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在绵绵不绝的雨中，女孩独自在雾蒙蒙的林屋里等待着她的主人。
师父有时会反复无常地来，辱骂一下女孩，然后又离开。但对于女孩来说，他就是世界上的一切。
有一天，一个陌生的男孩和一个侄女出现在等待的女孩面前。雨会永远停吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
